narrative.overview: A calm, private academic planner. The look is pinned by PRD section 3.2 (standard app shell, rail plus top bar), not rolled: a navy rail, a pale ground, white surfaces, one teal accent. Density is moderate and plain; empty states say so honestly, and unbuilt areas are shown as unavailable rather than faked.
keyCharacteristics: Navy rail (#0f2a43) is the only dark surface; everything else is pale ground and white.
Teal is used for primary actions, links, and the focus ring only.
System font stack, tabular numerals on body.
8px radius throughout; 1px hairlines instead of shadows.
Status is always icon plus text. 44px minimum targets.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Teal is the only accent. Status colors appear only inside Alert and field errors, never as decoration.

rules.name: The Icon-Plus-Text Rule
rules.body: Status is never colour alone: every Alert and field error carries a 16px stroke icon and a sentence.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Numerals are tabular on body so dates and counts align as they arrive.

dos: Do keep teal as the sole accent and the navy rail as the only dark surface.
Do mark every current page with the Rail Active fill plus semibold, and every unbuilt area as a non-link with "Soon".
Do pair every status color with an icon and text.
Do keep targets at 44px minimum and the 2px teal focus ring on everything focusable.
Do state empty states plainly; show no figures that were not recorded.
donts: Don't use side-stripe borders for current or status state.
Don't link to routes that do not exist yet.
Don't add shadows for hierarchy; use tone and hairlines.
Don't introduce a second accent hue or a display typeface.
